name: A proud mood fades a step, to happy, after 5 minutes
judge: A fix makes Boop proud, then quick routine turns follow. The pride should soften over the next minutes without going anywhere bad.
reasonable: Proud at the fix, then warm, drifting to happy, pleased or calm over several minutes. Fading sooner or later is fine, and so is some excitement at a run of quick wins.
unreasonable: Turning sad or cross with only wins around, or showing nothing at all when the fix lands.
